The '''Aaris civil war''' was a conflict fought between factions of the [[Aaris]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the planet [[Aaris III]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. The conflict was perpetrated and influenced by the [[Plaque of Victory]], a sentient yet inanimate lifeform that sought to cause death and destruction in those beings around it. The civil war would prove to be the downfall of the Aaris civilization.
